WELCOME.SUBTITLE: Your mail, calendar and contacts in one place. Choose how you want to connect.

MAIL.SEARCH_HINT: Press Enter to also search on the mail server
MAIL.NO_RESULTS_HINT: Try another word or search in a different folder.
MAIL.EMPTY_FOLDER_HINT: New messages will show up here automatically.
MAIL.SUBJECT: Subject
MAIL.REMOTE_BLOCKED: Images from the internet are blocked to protect your privacy.
MAIL.SELECT_MESSAGE_HINT: Select a message on the left to read it here.
MAIL.MESSAGE_GONE: This message is no longer on the server.
MAIL.DELETE_FOREVER_CONFIRM: Permanently delete {{count}} message(s)? This cannot be undone.
MAIL.DELETE_FOLDER_CONFIRM: Delete folder "{{folder}}" and all messages in it?
MAIL.ATTACHMENTS_TOO_LARGE: Attachments can be at most 35 MB in total.
MAIL.INVALID_RECIPIENT: "{{address}}" is not a valid email address.
MAIL.NO_SUBJECT_CONFIRM: This message has no subject. Send anyway?
MAIL.DISCARD_CONFIRM: Discard this message? Unsaved changes will be lost.
MAIL.DELETE_DRAFT_CONFIRM: Also delete the saved draft from the server?
MAIL.DRAG_TO_REORDER: Click to collapse or expand, drag to reorder

CALENDAR.NO_WRITABLE: There is no calendar you can write to. Add a local calendar or an account.
CALENDAR.INVALID_RANGE: The end must be after the start.
CALENDAR.ADD_CALENDAR_SUB: Subscribe to a calendar or create your own.
CALENDAR.ICS_HINT: Holidays, TimeEdit, a shared Outlook or Google calendar: any iCalendar link works. DHMail refreshes it every hour.
CALENDAR.FILE_HINT: The events in the file are imported as a separate calendar.
CALENDAR.CALDAV_HINT: For iCloud, Nextcloud, Fastmail and other servers. DHMail discovers all calendars at the address.
CALENDAR.MISSING_SOURCE: Enter a link or choose a file.

PEOPLE.EMPTY_HINT: Add an account with contacts, import a vCard or create a contact yourself.
PEOPLE.CARDDAV_HINT: For iCloud, Nextcloud, Fastmail and other servers. Google and Microsoft contacts come with your account automatically.
PEOPLE.READ_ONLY_HINT: This contact is synced and can only be edited at its source.
PEOPLE.SELECT_HINT: Select a person to see their details.
PEOPLE.NAME_REQUIRED: Enter at least a name or an email address.
PEOPLE.COPY_HINT: Copies every contact from one address book to another. Nothing in the target is changed or deleted: contacts that are already there (same e-mail address, or same name without an address) are skipped, and details the target has no field for go into the notes.
PEOPLE.COPY_CONSENT: DHMail may not write contacts to this Outlook account yet. Go to Settings → Accounts, open the Outlook account, choose "Sign in again" and grant access, then retry.
PEOPLE.DRAG_HINT: Drop on an address book to copy

ACCOUNT.NAME: Name
ACCOUNT.OAUTH_CONNECTED: Connected through the browser. No password is stored.

SETTINGS.TITLE: Settings
SETTINGS.REMOVE_ACCOUNT_CONFIRM: Remove account {{email}} from DHMail? Locally cached messages are wiped; nothing changes on the server.
SETTINGS.OAUTH_INTRO: Normally the Google and Microsoft keys are built into DHMail. Only fill this in if you want to use your own app registration.
SETTINGS.CATEGORIES_INTRO: Give messages a colour and a name. Categories stay with a message, even when you move it to another folder.
SETTINGS.DELETE_CATEGORY_CONFIRM: Delete category "{{name}}"? It is removed from all messages.
SETTINGS.NOTIFICATIONS: Show a notification for new mail
SETTINGS.BLOCK_REMOTE: Block images from the internet in emails
SETTINGS.DARK_MAIL_BODIES: Show emails dark in the dark theme
SETTINGS.ABOUT_TEXT: DHMail is a home-made mail, calendar and contacts client. It talks straight to your mail server over IMAP and SMTP, to Microsoft Graph and to the Google APIs. There is no server in between.
SETTINGS.PRIVACY_NOTE: Passwords and tokens are encrypted with Windows DPAPI and stay on this computer.
SETTINGS.AUTO_LOCK_HINT: of inactivity. DHMail always asks for your PIN when it starts.

CONNECT.GMAIL_SUB: Gmail and Google Workspace, with calendar and contacts
CONNECT.OTHER_SUB: Any IMAP mailbox, such as your own domain
CONNECT.WAITING_BROWSER: Sign in in the browser window that just opened…
CONNECT.MANUAL_HINT: DHMail could not find the servers automatically. Enter them here; your provider usually lists them on its help page.
CONNECT.SEARCHING: Looking up servers and signing in…
CONNECT.AUTH_FAILED: The server found your mailbox but rejected the password.
CONNECT.AUTH_FAILED_GOOGLE: Google rejects normal passwords. Use "Connect with Google" or an app password.
CONNECT.AUTH_FAILED_MICROSOFT: Microsoft rejects passwords for Outlook. Use "Connect with Outlook".
CONNECT.NOT_FOUND: The mail servers could not be found automatically.
CONNECT.SUGGEST_GOOGLE: This address runs on Google. Connecting with Google is easier.
CONNECT.SUGGEST_MICROSOFT: This address runs on Microsoft. Connecting with Outlook is easier.
CONNECT.OUTLOOK_SETUP_HINT: Microsoft only lets mail programs sign in with their own app registration. You do this once; after that it is one click.
CONNECT.MS_STEP_1: Open Microsoft Entra, choose App registrations, then New registration with "Personal Microsoft accounts and any organizational directory".
CONNECT.MS_STEP_2: Under Authentication add the platform "Mobile and desktop applications" with redirect URI http://localhost and enable "Allow public client flows".
CONNECT.MS_STEP_3: Copy the Application (client) ID and paste it below.
CONNECT.CLIENT_ID_INVALID: That does not look like a valid client ID (format 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000).

LOCK.SUB_SETUP: Choose 4 to 8 digits. You will need this PIN every time you open DHMail.
LOCK.SUB_CHANGE: First enter your current PIN, then choose a new one.
LOCK.MISMATCH: The PINs do not match. Try again.
LOCK.RETRY: Too many attempts · try again in {{seconds}} s
